description: This file contains the PHP class 'Permission' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup' namespace. The class extends the base Controller class and includes a method 'index()' responsible for managing permission checks within the admin startup process of OpenCart. It handles route parsing, ignores certain routes from permission checks, and verifies user permissions, returning an error action if access is denied.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Controller class managing permission checks during startup in the admin section of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs access control by checking the route in the request, ignoring certain routes, and verifying user permissions. Redirects to an error page if permission is denied.
